title: Sign-in providers
description: Let people sign in with your organisation's identity provider or directory. Local accounts keep working alongside them.
localNote: New providers start disabled. Register the values shown on each card with your identity provider, test the connection, then switch it on — it then appears on the sign-in page.

empty.title: No sign-in providers yet
empty.description: Connect Microsoft Entra ID, any OpenID Connect or SAML 2.0 provider, or an LDAP / Active Directory server.

entra.title: Microsoft Entra ID
entra.description: Single sign-on for Microsoft 365 organisations. Scopes and claims are pre-filled — you only need the tenant ID, client ID and secret.

oidc.title: Generic OpenID Connect
oidc.description: Okta, Google Workspace, Keycloak, Auth0 or any other OpenID Connect provider.

saml.title: SAML 2.0
saml.description: AD FS, Shibboleth, PingFederate and other SAML identity providers.

ldap.title: LDAP / Active Directory
ldap.description: Sign in with directory passwords, and sync people and groups on a schedule.

endpoints.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the text and copy it manually.

hint.oidc: Fetches the provider's discovery document using the issuer and client ID.
hint.saml: Checks that the identity provider's signing certificate is valid.
hint.ldap: Binds with the service account and searches the base DN.

createDescription.entra: From the Entra admin center: App registrations → your app → Overview, and Certificates & secrets.
createDescription.oidc: Use the values from your provider's application or client settings.
createDescription.saml: Use the values from your identity provider's SAML metadata.
createDescription.ldap: A read-only service account is enough for sign-in and directory sync.

form.editDescription: Changes apply to the next sign-in and are recorded in the audit log.
form.name: Display name
form.keyHint: Used in URLs. Lowercase letters, digits, “-” and “_”; it can't be changed later.
form.keyLocked: The key is part of the URLs registered in your identity provider, so it can't be changed.
form.secretKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored value. Secrets are encrypted and never shown again.

entra.tenantHint: A GUID, or a verified domain such as contoso.onmicrosoft.com.
entra.issuerOverride: Built from the tenant ID. Change it only for sovereign clouds.
entra.clientSecretHint: The secret's Value (not its ID) from Certificates & secrets.

oidc.issuerHint: Settings are discovered from /.well-known/openid-configuration under this URL.
oidc.clientSecretHint: Leave empty only for public clients that rely on PKCE.
oidc.allowedDomainsHint: Only people with these email domains can sign in. Leave empty to allow any domain.

saml.entryPointHint: Where people are sent to sign in (the IdP's SSO / SingleSignOnService URL).
saml.issuerHint: Must match the identifier (audience) registered in your identity provider.
saml.certificateHint: PEM or base64, from the IdP's metadata. Used to verify signed responses.
saml.wantAssertionsSignedHint: Recommended. Rejects responses whose assertions aren't signed.

ldap.urlHint: Prefer ldaps:// (port 636) so passwords are encrypted in transit.
ldap.baseDnHint: People are searched for below this entry.
ldap.userFilterHint: {token} is replaced with the username people type.
ldap.verifyTlsHint: Turn off only for testing with self-signed certificates.

form.claimMappingHint: Which ID-token claims hold each value. Leave empty for the standard claim names.
form.samlAttributeHint: Assertion attribute names. Leave empty to use the common Microsoft / OASIS claim URIs.
form.jitHint: Otherwise only people who already have an account (matched by email) can sign in.
form.defaultDepartmentHint: Assigned to people created through this provider.
form.groupMappingsHint: Add people to platform groups based on the groups their provider reports. Membership is updated at every sign-in or sync.
form.syncEnabledHint: Creates and updates people from the directory and suspends those who disappear from it.
form.cronHint: Cron expression (minute hour day month weekday), in the server's time zone.
form.displayOrderHint: Lower numbers appear first on the sign-in page.

validation.url: Enter a full URL, starting with https://.
validation.format: This doesn't have the expected format.
validation.key: Use lowercase letters, digits, “-” and “_”, starting with a letter or digit.
validation.keyTaken: Another provider already uses this key.
validation.ldapUrl: Must start with ldap:// or ldaps://.
validation.cron: Enter a cron expression with 5 fields, e.g. 0 */6 * * *.
